questions.query: How does PagedAttention store the KV cache?
questions.reference_answer: PagedAttention stores the KV cache in blocks that need not be contiguous in physical memory.

evidence.text: PagedAttention stores the KV cache in blocks that need not occupy contiguous physical memory.

questions.query: Как PagedAttention размещает KV cache в памяти?
questions.reference_answer: PagedAttention хранит KV cache блоками, которым не требуется непрерывное размещение в физической памяти.

evidence.text: PagedAttention stores the KV cache in blocks that need not occupy contiguous physical memory.

questions.query: Compare the base weights and trainable parameters in LoRA and QLoRA.
questions.reference_answer: LoRA freezes pretrained weights and trains low-rank weight updates. QLoRA trains low-rank adapters through a frozen base model stored in 4-bit precision.

evidence.text: LoRA freezes the pretrained weights and trains low-rank matrices for weight updates.
QLoRA trains low-rank adapters through a frozen base model stored in 4-bit precision.

questions.query: Сравни базовые веса и обучаемые параметры LoRA и QLoRA.
questions.reference_answer: LoRA замораживает предобученные веса и обучает низкоранговые обновления. QLoRA обучает низкоранговые адаптеры через замороженную базовую модель, хранящуюся в 4-битной точности.

evidence.text: LoRA freezes the pretrained weights and trains low-rank matrices for weight updates.
QLoRA trains low-rank adapters through a frozen base model stored in 4-bit precision.

questions.query: Which roles do the draft and target models play in speculative decoding?
questions.reference_answer: A small draft model proposes tokens and a larger target model verifies them.

evidence.text: Speculative decoding lets a small draft model propose tokens that a larger target model verifies.

questions.query: Какие роли выполняют draft и target модели в speculative decoding?
questions.reference_answer: Малая draft-модель предлагает токены, а более крупная target-модель проверяет их.

evidence.text: Speculative decoding lets a small draft model propose tokens that a larger target model verifies.
